The Phillips Curve shows that there is an inverse relationship between inflation and unemployment in the short run.
Inflation (or price level) increases as unemployment decreases.
This relationship exists because when more people work, they can produce more goods and services at lower prices.
However, this relationship does not exist in the long run because:
1. The economy has to be able to supply enough jobs for everyone who wants one.
